name: KopierMaschine
summary: KopierMaschine (Copy Machine) is a trade copying utility EA that replicates trades from a source account or symbol to one or more destination accounts/symbols. It functions as a signal copier rather than an autonomous trading strategy, handling both local and remote trade duplication with configurable lot scaling and filtering options.
summary_zh: KopierMaschine（复制机）是一个交易复制工具EA，用于将源账户或交易品种的交易复制到一个或多个目标账户/交易品种。它作为信号复制器而非自主交易策略运行，支持本地和远程交易复制，并具有可配置的手数缩放和过滤选项。
strategy_analysis: 该EA并非自主交易策略，而是一个交易复制工具。其核心功能是监控源账户的交易活动（开仓、平仓、修改止损止盈等），然后将这些操作同步复制到目标账户。入场和出场条件完全取决于源账户的操作，EA本身不产生任何交易信号。仓位管理通过手数缩放因子实现，可以根据目标账户资金大小调整复制的手数比例。资金管理方面，EA依赖源账户的风险控制，自身仅负责忠实复制交易动作。该工具适用于需要在不同账户间同步交易的场景，如资金管理人在多个客户账户间复制交易策略。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not an autonomous trading strategy but a trade copying utility. Its core function is to monitor trading activity on a source account (opening, closing, modifying stops and take-profits) and then synchronously replicate these operations to destination accounts. Entry and exit conditions depend entirely on the source account's actions; the EA itself generates no trading signals. Position sizing is handled through a lot scaling factor, which adjusts the copied lot size proportionally based on the destination account's balance relative to the source. Money management relies on the source account's risk controls, as the EA is solely responsible for faithfully replicating trade actions. This tool is suitable for scenarios requiring trade synchronization across multiple accounts, such as money managers copying strategies across client accounts.

parameters.name: LotScaleFactor
parameters.description: 手数缩放因子，用于调整复制到目标账户的手数比例
parameters.description_en: Lot scaling factor for adjusting copied lot ratio

parameters.name: SourceSymbol
parameters.description: 源交易品种名称，指定从哪个品种复制交易
parameters.description_en: Source symbol name for trade copying

parameters.name: CopyTrades
parameters.description: 是否复制交易操作的总开关
parameters.description_en: Master switch for enabling trade copying

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 魔术编号，用于标识复制来源的交易
parameters.description_en: Magic number filter for order selection

parameters.name: CopyStopLoss
parameters.description_en: Whether to copy stop loss settings

parameters.name: CopyTakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Whether to copy take profit settings

parameters.name: ReverseMode
parameters.description: 反向复制模式，将买入复制为卖出反之亦然
parameters.description_en: Reverse copy mode: buy copied as sell and vice versa

pros: 可以在多个账户间高效同步交易，适合资金管理人使用
手数缩放功能允许根据目标账户资金大小灵活调整仓位
支持反向复制模式，提供更多交易复制策略的灵活性
pros_en: Efficiently synchronizes trades across multiple accounts, ideal for money managers
Lot scaling feature allows flexible position adjustment based on destination account size
Reverse copy mode provides additional flexibility for trade copying strategies
cons: 作为复制工具本身不产生交易信号，完全依赖源账户的交易质量
缺乏对复制失败的完善错误处理和重试机制
没有内置的风险检查，可能在目标账户资金不足时仍然尝试复制交易
cons_en: As a copying tool, it generates no trading signals and relies entirely on source account trade quality
Lacks robust error handling and retry mechanisms for copy failures
No built-in risk checks may attempt to copy trades even when destination account has insufficient funds
improvements: 增加复制失败的重试机制和详细日志记录
添加目标账户资金充足性检查，防止因资金不足导致复制失败
增加交易过滤功能，如按品种、方向或手数大小过滤
improvements_en: Add retry mechanism and detailed logging for copy failures
Implement destination account sufficiency checks to prevent copy failures due to insufficient funds
Add trade filtering capabilities, such as filtering by symbol, direction, or lot size

risk_points: 复制延迟可能导致目标账户成交价格与源账户不同
如果源账户使用高频策略，复制可能跟不上节奏导致滑点过大
risk_points_en: Copy latency may cause destination account fill prices to differ from the source account
If the source account uses high-frequency strategies, copying may not keep pace, leading to excessive slippage

It functions as a signal copier rather than an autonomous trading strategy, handling both local and remote trade duplication with configurable lot scaling and filtering options.
